question: A is the wife of B. B is the brother of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/170edd7ecf8219a602a0814016655280345ebb732ef6d85511f86a7a49b371b7.png] 

Given:

1) A is the wife of B.

2) B is the brother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/578a47f0848939a5d867b6055597f717d1521172d9bcfddd10e514eb8b46758c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86d6fd17d890a8b02d7ee91cc9c28b435276939853b755735915c922a7cc4c1c.png] 

3) C is the father of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/939b8eb0bcaf3a845569701b251de639a2b4c21a75c2ad75850a4802cd173b7d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c85a5bff9723120a03031684311ef8bc04296d1e79b23e2970783b4ca4256913.png] 

Thus, A is D's aunt.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
